description: HTTP playground against httpbin.org: echoes back query parameters, bodies and headers, and can answer with any status code or delay.

get.description: GET /get — httpbin echoes the query parameters and headers of the request.

input.name: query.*
input.description: Any key/value pairs, sent as query string parameters. Echoed back under body.args.

input.name: headers.*
input.description: Extra request headers. Echoed back under body.headers.

output.description: The echoed request: args (query), headers and url.

get.example:
application: httpbin
method: get
parameters:
  query:
    q: flows
test:
  status: 200
  body:
    args:
      q: flows

post.description: POST /post — httpbin echoes the JSON body back under "json".

input.name: body.*
input.description: Any JSON payload. Replacers such as {{ randomEmail }} are handy here.

output.description: The echoed request; the parsed JSON payload is available under body.json.

post.example:
application: httpbin
method: post
parameters:
  body:
    email: "{{ randomEmail }}"
test:
  status: 200
  body:
    json:
      email: "$expr: typeof value === 'string' && value.includes('@')"

status.description: GET /status/{code} — httpbin answers with exactly that HTTP status code.

input.name: params.code
input.description: The HTTP status code to receive (e.g. 200, 404, 503).

output.description: An empty body with the requested status code.

status.example:
application: httpbin
method: status
parameters:
  params:
    code: 404
test:
  status: 404

delay.description: GET /delay/{seconds} — httpbin waits before responding (max 10 seconds).

input.name: params.seconds
input.description: Seconds to wait before the response (0-10).

output.description: Same echo format as /get, after the delay.

delay.example:
application: httpbin
method: delay
parameters:
  params:
    seconds: 2
test:
  status: 200
